library.name: Kobalte
library.description: Unstyled, accessible SolidJS primitives with composable APIs and data attributes for custom styling.

pricing.summary: Kobalte is free and open source under the MIT license.

components.name: Button
components.summary: An accessible button with disabled-state behavior and native keyboard activation.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal dialog with focus management, dismissal, and an original styled portal.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Keyboard-accessible tabs with a moving selection indicator and content panels.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal an associated section of content.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.summary: A modal dialog that interrupts the user's workflow to communicate an important message and acquire a response. Examples include action confirmation prompts and error message confirmations. The alertdialog role enables assistive technologies and browsers to distinguish alert dialogs from other dialogs so they have the option of giving alert dialogs special treatment, such as playing a system alert sound.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Display a brief, important message in a way that attracts the user's attention without interrupting the user's task.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A `Badge` component is used to display small pieces of information or status indicators.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: Show hierarchy and navigational context for a user’s location within an application.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: An interactive component which expands/collapses a content.

components.name: Color Area
components.summary: Allows users to adjust two channels of an RGB, HSL, or HSB color value against a two-dimensional gradient background.

components.name: Color Channel Field
components.summary: A number input that allow users to edit individual color channel value.

components.name: Color Field
components.summary: Allows users to enter and adjust a hex color value.

components.name: Color Slider
components.summary: Adjusts an individual channel of a color value.

components.name: Color Swatch
components.summary: Displays a preview of a selected color.

components.name: Color Wheel
components.summary: Allows users to adjust the hue of an HSL or HSB color value on a circular track.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Combines a text input with a listbox, allowing users to filter a list of options to items matching a query.

components.name: Context Menu
components.summary: Displays a menu located at the pointer, triggered by a right-click or a long-press.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.summary: Displays a menu to the user —such as a set of actions or functions— triggered by a button.

components.name: File Field
components.summary: A file input to upload multiple files, with ability to drag and drop files.

components.name: Hover Card
components.summary: Allows sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

components.name: Image
components.summary: An image element with an optional fallback for loading and error status.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Allows a user to navigate to another page or resource within a web page or application.

components.name: Menubar
components.summary: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.

components.name: Meter
components.summary: Displays numeric value that varies within a defined range

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.summary: A collection of links for navigating websites.

components.name: Number Field
components.summary: A number input that allow users to input custom number entries with a keyboard.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Allows the user to select a specific page from a range of pages.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A popover positioned relative to an anchor element.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Show either determinate or indeterminate progress of an operation over time.

components.name: Radio Group
components.summary: A set of checkable buttons, known as radio buttons, where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

components.name: Rating
components.summary: Allows users to rate items using a set of icons.

components.name: Search
components.summary: Search a searchbox text input with a menu. Handle the case where dataset filtering needs to occur outside the combobox component.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.summary: A linear set of two or more segments, each of which functions as a radio input, and a default value is required.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from — triggered by a button.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: Visually or semantically separates content.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Visually indicates content loading

components.name: Slider
components.summary: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A control that allows users to choose one of two values: on or off.

components.name: Text Field
components.summary: A text input that allow users to input custom text entries with a keyboard.

components.name: Time Field
components.summary: A time field allows users to enter and edit time values using a keyboard. Each part of a time value is displayed in an individually editable segment.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

components.name: Toggle Button
components.summary: A two-state button that can be either on (pressed) or off (not pressed).

components.name: Toggle Group
components.summary: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on (pressed) or off (not pressed).

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

components.name: I18n Provider
components.summary: Provides the locale for the application to all child components.

compatibility.subject: tailwindcss
compatibility.constraint: v3 uses @kobalte/tailwindcss; v4 uses native data attributes
